# Macros are not ambient: a macro resolves through an imported macro package,
# the same as any other qualified or dot-imported name. Nothing else covered
# this, so both halves could be reverted to the old ambient lookup with a green
# suite.
#
# `tree.none` is the macro under test — sngl:ui/draw declares none now that
# membership is the return position, and sngl:tree no longer declares `kind`
# now that a family is a component.

# A qualified macro needs its package imported.
! sngl check no_import.sngl
stderr 'unknown macro package "tree": import it with import "sngl:tree"'

sngl check qualified.sngl
stdout 'qualified.sngl: ok'

# An unqualified macro resolves against dot-imported macro packages only.
! sngl check bare_builtin.sngl
stderr 'unknown macro "builtin": nothing in scope declares it'

# A lib package carries its macros alongside its declarations, so importing
# sngl:tree brings both the count wrappers and the mark beside them.
sngl check with_std.sngl
stdout 'with_std.sngl: ok'

# The alias is the caller's, and the macro follows it.
sngl check aliased.sngl
stdout 'aliased.sngl: ok'

# A macro exists because a package declares it, so a mark naming one the
# package does not declare says exactly that. sngl:i18n declares no macros at
# all; tree, which does, is one import line away.
! sngl check no_macros.sngl
stderr 'unknown macro "none": package "sngl:i18n" declares none of that name'

-- no_import.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

#[tree.none]
component quiet() {}

ui.window {
    quiet()
}
-- qualified.sngl --
import "sngl:tree"
import ui "sngl:ui"

#[tree.none]
component quiet() {}

ui.window {
    quiet()
}
-- bare_builtin.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

#[builtin("int")]
struct Fake {
    v int
}

ui.window {
}
-- with_std.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import tr "sngl:tree"

#[tr.none]
component quiet() {}

component main node {
    vbox() {
        quiet()
        text(value="beside a widget")
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- aliased.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import whatever "sngl:tree"

#[whatever.none]
component quiet() {}

window {
    quiet()
}
-- no_macros.sngl --
import b "sngl:i18n"
import ui "sngl:ui"

#[b.none]
component quiet() {}

ui.window {
    quiet()
}
